title: Data assimilation for slightly compressible flow
summary: Continuous data assimilation (CDA) nudges observational data into governing equations to recover the underlying flow and improve predictions. Existing rigorous CDA analyses focus primarily on incompressible flows, yet no physical flow is perfectly incompressible. Approximating a slightly compressible flow with an incompressible model introduces non-negligible model errors. Data assimilation for compressible flows remains challenging due to strong nonlinearities and the presence of shocks.
